(avasarāla)padmarāja(ju)
alias Varṇādhikabhojarāja, niyogi brahmin of Bhāradvāja gotra; minister of Rāvu Nīlādrirao of Pithapuram (C. 1800 A. D.).
-- Bālabhāgavatacampū or Padmarājacampū. Adyar D. V. 918. MD. 12320.
See P. Sriramamurthi, Contr. of Andhra to Skt. Lit. p. 137.
Pt.. in Telugu script. Sarvani Press. Amalapuram, 1908.

(Āvañca)_Rāmacandra
son of Gaṅgāmbikā an. Koṇḍo Paṇḍita of Sāṇḍilyagotra of Kañjalūru of Andhra.
See under Rāmacandra Budhendra. |24|81

(Āvañca)_Rāmacandra_Budhendra

--C. Bhagavadbhaktirasāyana on Kṛṣṇakarṇāmṛta of Līlāśukayogī.
